subject: Reopened: review CHANGES REQUIRED (2 high, 5 medium, 5 low) — decisions inside
body:
reviewer-opus: CHANGES REQUIRED at 300499e. Lead decisions — fix all:

1. HIGH undo/redo vs LWW: undo/redo emit items with updatedAt = now (deletes become fresh tombstones / re-adds fresh); unit test: undo/redo survive mergeInkItems against a replica that saw the intermediate state.
2. HIGH canvas memory: one module-level budget shared by ALL engines counting ink + marker + live canvases; release backing stores (width=height=0) once a slab settles to an image, recreate on next edit; LRU eviction across surfaces; tests mounting N surfaces; add a dpr-2 iPad project for the ink spec.
3. MEDIUM marker: per-surface option — "under" for plain text surfaces, "over + mix-blend-mode: multiply" for image/PDF/table surfaces (HANDOFF §5.3); default by surface type; visual test over an opaque table row.
4. MEDIUM lasso/ask without ink: lasso and "Ask Naadi" emit {bbox, path} even when no ink is selected; document that the PNG is ink-only and the consumer composites page content + surrounding text (14/15 will).
5. MEDIUM ink-lab gate: when signed in, the gate uses /api/me (features.ink_lab honouring the app_config audience=admins rule seg05 is wiring); public-config only when signed out; e2e with APP_ENV=prod: admin sees the lab, student gets Page not found; remove the stale VITE_FEATURE_INK_LAB comment/skip.
6. MEDIUM scroll gate: assert ink ≥ 0.7 × ink-hidden AND ≥ 25 fps absolute; rename the test (no "60 fps"); docs/DEVICE_CHECKLIST.md: "60 fps (120 on ProMotion) with ~5k strokes, measured with the lab's Measure scroll; record the number". Investigate the WebKit ~30% overhead (compositing of the absolutely positioned ink layer/images — try a single composited layer, will-change, contain) and make the gate stable on WebKit laptop.
7. MEDIUM black swatch: visible ring when unselected (WCAG 1.4.11); test.
8. LOW-MED latency harness: pendingLatencyTs set only when null (first unpainted input); re-record PROGRESS numbers.
9. LOW-MED Firefox crash outside axe (spec:332): adopt the frozen-DOM axe helper (decision 01a195 item 1, seg03 lands it on shared) and rerun Firefox lasso ×10; if crashes persist, investigate as engine/memory.
10. LOW sync work in handler: move erase/split commits out of pointermove into the rAF frame; make live-stroke outline incremental or bounded; encode settle images off the main thread (createImageBitmap / OffscreenCanvas where available); measure.
11. LOW InkSurface `enabled` defaults to false (or make it required).
12. LOW "Ink on" is the single lime next action per the Ink board; phone toolbar = one horizontally scrollable row (no 3-row wrap); full-page phone screenshots so states are visible.
Keep temp files in your worktree. Re-run vitest, the ink e2e matrix (2 workers), integrate, post done.
